advisor_identified: Pierre H. (Pierre Henri) Boulle, historian of France and French colonial history at McGill University.

doctorate.title: The French Colonies and the Reform of Their Administration during and following the Seven Years' War

evidence.says: The 2004–2005 McGill calendar lists history associate professor Pierre H. Boulle with A.B. (Indiana), M.A. (Stanford), and Ph.D. (California).
The 1999–2000 graduate calendar, History staff section (printed p. 186), lists P.H. Boulle as an associate professor with Ph.D. (Calif.).

Acadie: Guide bibliographique, entry 0066 (PDF p. 9), identifies Pierre-Henri Boulle's The French Colonies and the Reform of Their Administration During and Following the Seven Years' War as a Ph.D. thesis at the University of California, Berkeley, 1968.

The authority record equates Pierre H. Boulle with Pierre Henri Boulle, identifies him as a McGill professor, and lists the same dissertation title among his works through the SUDOC catalogue. The listed facsimile reproduction has copyright date 1969.

The indexed title page identifies Emmanuelle Carle's McGill History PhD thesis, Gabrielle Duchêne et la recherche d'une autre route, as April 2005. Its indexed acknowledgements (p. iv) thank Pierre Boulle and name Norman Ingram as co-supervisor.

notes: The advisor’s name variants, McGill affiliation, California PhD, and exact dissertation title establish the match. The 1969 date in the facsimile catalogue description is a reproduction date; the university bibliography dates the PhD to 1968. The student thesis evidence was available through search-indexed front matter; direct PDF retrieval failed.
